facts.fact: Gabon Info reports the launch of SIGFIP, the integrated public finance management system, which centralises processing of the state's expenditure and revenue on one platform, per the delegate budget minister and ANINF's deputy director general.
Gabon Info reports the launch of the new SIGFIP public finance system in January 2026, which the minister says the administration developed in-house and whose source code it owns.

GAB.note: The Treasury data centre is not said to rent capacity to others.
Nothing on the national ID system.

facts.fact: Gabon Info quotes the delegate budget minister saying SIGFIP was developed in-house and that the Gabonese administration now owns its source codes, with ANINF's deputy director general presenting the system.
Gabon Info reports the launch of SIGFIP, which the delegate budget minister says was developed in-house.
Gabon Info reports the state's SIGFIP public finance system, with the budget data of revenue, spending and debt, is run from the Treasury data centre in Gabon under state control.

GAB.note: Nothing on school internet or the curriculum.
ANINF only encourages startups in a remark; no law, label or fund.
No hub or technology park is stated.
